summary: Computes a running sum of an input attribute across points, vertices, or primitives and writes the result to a new or existing attribute. Inclusive scan includes the current element; exclusive scan starts from the previous accumulated value.

key_params.name: attrclass
key_params.note: Point, vertex, or primitive attribute class

key_params.name: inputattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute or components to accumulate

key_params.name: attrtype
key_params.note: Output data type when overriding automatic typing

key_params.name: attrdefaultval
key_params.note: Default output value if accumulation cannot be computed

key_concepts: Accumulate POP computes a running sum, or scan, over the selected point, vertex, or primitive attribute class.
Inclusive scan includes the current element in its output value, while exclusive scan reports the accumulated value before the current element.
Output attribute scope and override controls let scan results keep the input type shape or write into a manually typed attribute.
common_gotchas: Accumulation depends on element order, so run Sort POP first if the running sum needs a specific traversal.
Exclusive scan intentionally leaves the first output at zero/default; use inclusive scan for cumulative totals including the current element.
Accumulating vector attributes preserves vector shape, which is useful but can hide per-component growth.
